$comment: Every foreground/background token pairing the site uses, checked against WCAG 2.2 AA by test/a11y/contrast.test.js (no browser). kind: text = 4.5:1, large = 3:1 (24px, or 18.66px bold), ui = 3:1 (borders, focus rings, icons). A translucent background names the surface it sits 'over'. A pair that fails needs a waiver with an owner and a reason, or a fix in Figma and the tokens.

pairs.where: accent buttons, 'Drop 01' and hero badges (14-16px bold)

ink-50 on white (text).reason: Figma 2:460 sets the label at ink 50%; needs ink 60% or darker.

orange on white (text).reason: Specified in Figma; raised in the PULSE design-system prompt (text-safe orange, e.g. an orange-700 for text on light backgrounds).

orange on orange-tint (text).reason: Specified in Figma; raised in the PULSE design-system prompt (text-safe orange, e.g. an orange-700 for text on light backgrounds).

orange on white (ui).reason: Specified in Figma; raised in the PULSE design-system prompt (text-safe orange, e.g. an orange-700 for text on light backgrounds).

white on orange (text).reason: Figma accent fills carry white text; needs a darker accent fill or ink text.

orange on surface (large).reason: Specified in Figma; raised in the PULSE design-system prompt (text-safe orange, e.g. an orange-700 for text on light backgrounds).

orange on blue (text).reason: Figma stats band sets orange labels on blue; needs white or a lighter accent.

blue on ink (large).reason: Figma hero sets a blue accent word on ink; needs a lighter blue on dark backgrounds.

orange on orange-tint (large).reason: Specified in Figma; raised in the PULSE design-system prompt (text-safe orange, e.g. an orange-700 for text on light backgrounds).
